failure_modes.cause: Inferred names/traits or broad question match
failure_modes.detection: Explicit-value, blank, exact option and radio-group tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Saved values only; editable separate names; local exact/semantic field matching; leave unknown answers for takeover

failure_modes.detection: Profile merge and legacy alias tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Use existing validated deep merge; preserve unknown keys; keep legacy address/state/EEO compatibility

failure_modes.mode: Input order or final approval races
failure_modes.mitigation: Bounded atomic validation; FIFO batches; flush before control actions; preserve final guards and page-bound approval

failure_modes.mode: Stream leaks another workspace or survives logout
failure_modes.mitigation: Same-origin authenticated route; ownership check; periodic reauthentication; stop streams on hidden/closed views

failure_modes.mode: Hot path bypasses authorization or overloads worker
failure_modes.detection: Fast-path, batch cap and frame cadence tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Retain server CSRF and session ownership; manual-only input; bounded queue/actions; throttled capture and inspection
